sdkDependencies.policy: Top-level dependencies[] is the explicit dependency SDK family contract for this gateway.

dependencyApiSurfaces.policy: Top-level apiSurfaces[] plus dependencies[] are the explicit dependency API surface contract.

sharedUtilities.usage: boolean env toggles and HTTP path normalization in gateway runtime

rules: sdkwork-iam-app-api is restricted to appbase IAM dependency route patterns
sdkwork-iam-backend-api is restricted to backend IAM dependency route patterns
specific dependency route patterns must resolve before broad fallback dependency prefixes when prefixes overlap

sdkwork-commerce-app-api is a broad app fallback for remaining /app/v3/api paths after fixed appbase, Drive, Notary, RTC, Agent, AIoT, Memory, Knowledgebase, News, Notes, Music, Generations, Community, CMS, Forum, Search, Voice, Image, Comments, Course, Messaging, SdkworkIm, Appstore, Doudizhu, Gameengine, Mahjong, Xiangqi, Documents, Prompts, Deploy, Web, Modelkit, and other more specific dependency routes

sdkwork-commerce-backend-api is a broad backend fallback for remaining /backend/v3/api paths after fixed appbase backend IAM, Drive, Notary, RTC, Agent, AIoT, Memory, Knowledgebase, News, Notes, Music, Generations, Community, CMS, Forum, Search, Voice, Image, Comments, Course, Messaging, SdkworkIm, Appstore, Doudizhu, Gameengine, Mahjong, Xiangqi, Documents, Prompts, Deploy, Web, Modelkit, and other more specific dependency routes
sdkwork-im-im-http routes /im/v3/api/* paths for IM presence, realtime, chat, social, streams, calls, and media APIs
sdkwork-im-backend-http routes /backend/v3/api/control/*, /backend/v3/api/audit/*, and /backend/v3/api/ops/* paths for control plane, audit, and operations APIs
sdkwork-claw-gateway routes /v1/* paths for OpenAI-compatible API passthrough
non-appbase dependency surfaces route by apiPrefix/{*path}

workspace foundation dependency surfaces are added only when existing SDK assembly plus materialized OpenAPI paths or normalized route manifest evidence provides a stable route prefix; empty or generic-only SDK assemblies are not gateway startup dependencies
one dependency SDK family may declare multiple apiPrefixes when its materialized path set spans multiple stable prefixes; all prefixes share the same serviceId and requiredBaseUrlKey
foundation dependency executable evidence is declared through Cargo workspace dependencies and runtime Cargo features
split-only dependency surfaces must not declare cargoFeature, cargoDependency, or embeddedExecutableExport
do not maintain a separate gateway catalog when Cargo metadata and SDKWork specs already describe the integration
explicit embedded routers override split upstream proxying for matched dependency HTTP routes
split mode supports WebSocket proxying for configured dependency prefixes
observability access/audit sample rates must be between 0 and 10000 basis points
request.maxBodyBytes and policy.rules[].maxBodyBytes must be greater than 0
upstreams[].serviceId and upstreams[].baseUrl must be non-empty
dependencySurfaces[].serviceId and dependencySurfaces[].apiPrefix must be non-empty
traffic.rateLimits[].id, traffic.concurrencyLimits[].id, and policy.rules[].id must be non-empty
traffic.concurrencyLimits[].maxInFlight must be greater than 0

accessLog.failureClassPolicy: bounded gateway failure classes only; no raw path, request id, trace id, token, tenant, user, or IP address values

auditLog.classificationPolicy: bounded security and traffic decision values; no token, tenant, user, or IP address values

metrics.labelPolicy: bounded labels only; no raw path, request id, trace id, token, tenant, user, or IP address labels

diagnostics.exclusionPolicy: no upstream base URLs, raw request paths, request ids, trace ids, headers, tokens, tenant, user, organization, IP address, or live request data

metrics.scopePolicy: policy rule id only; no raw request path, request id, trace id, token, tenant, user, or IP address labels

dryRunBehavior: allowedMethods violations are forwarded and counted as method_not_allowed dry-run observations
policy maxBodyBytes overrides do not replace request.maxBodyBytes while dryRun is true
Content-Length values above a matching policy maxBodyBytes are counted as request_body_too_large dry-run observations

circuitBreaker.failurePolicy: consecutive split-mode upstream responses with 5xx status open the circuit

requestTimeoutBehavior.appliesTo: split-mode dependency upstream proxy budget until response headers
requestTimeoutBehavior.metricsBehavior: records bounded gateway_request_timeout resilience event and 504 upstream request series when the gateway budget expires
